Cinnamon Red Hots Sorbet
By: Chris Paulk
Published: Sunday, February 13, 2011 - 11:37pm

Ingredients




1 6 OZ BOX OF CINNAMON RED HOTS
2 cups OF WATER
 cup SUGAR

Preparation

1 PUT ALL THE INGREDIENTS IN A SAUCEPAN. 2 OVER LOW HEAT, BRING THE WATER TO A LOW SIMMER AND STIR TO DISSOLVE THE RED HOT CANDIES. 3 CONTINUE COOKING FOR ABOUT 15-20 MINUTES UNTIL THE LIQUID IS REDUCED BY ABOUT 1/4 CUP. 4 REMOVE FROM HEAT AND LET COOL TO ROOM TEMPERATURE. 5 POUR INTO A GLASS PIE PAN AND FREEZE. 6 WHEN FROZEN USE AN ICECREAM SCOOP OR MELON BALLER TO SCOOP OUT. 7 NOTE: I SERVE THIS WITH A SCOOP OF VANILLA ICE CREAM WITH GRATED CHOCOLATE AND A COOKIE FOR CRUNCH.  A DELICIOUS TREAT!

About


You can make sorbet from anything, so let your imagination go wild. I was planning a dinner just days before Valentine’s Day and I thought it would be a hoot and really interesting to make a sorbet from Cinnamon Red Hots. You know- you had them when you were a kid. They’re much harder to find than they used to be- but they’re still available. You can add them to hot cocoa, applesauce or hot pickles, but I love them in this spicy and simple sorbet!
